source_snapshot.items: PLDM Firmware Update Support via BMC web when boot into OS
source_snapshot.procedure: Keep the host in standby/do not power on, use BMC Web GPU Management > Firmware, choose the image and Start update.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL follows standby and suggests Redfish assistance, but cannot resolve the title's OS-booted state or replace WebUI evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires an authoritative host-state choice, signed image/target, visual WebUI evidence, uninterrupted update/activation, rollback/OOB and post-recovery version/health proof.

old_problem: The title requires update while booted into OS, but Procedure explicitly requires standby and not powering on; these states exercise different PLDM routes, availability and activation risk.
disposition_reason: No approved rule selects OS-on versus standby or permits merging them. Firmware flash must preserve the exact approved state and visual BMC-Web workflow, and ED-07 requires independent flash authorization plus pre/post version evidence. Parameterization cannot choose the missing test state.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row170 all18 XLSX cells and history2776.
Preserved both contradictory state requirements and genuine WebUI visual evidence.
Kept flash, activation and recovery separately gated; no image selection, flash, power change or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: PLDM GPU firmware update through BMC Web pending authoritative host power state
test_case.purpose: After project authority selects OS-booted or standby/BMC-only state, validate the signed GPU firmware image can be updated through the real BMC Web PLDM path with uninterrupted progress, correct activation and post-recovery health.
required_package: Authoritative decision: OS booted, standby/BMC-only, or separately versioned variants
Signed firmware image/checksum, exact GPU/board target, current/target versions and compatibility matrix
BMC Web UI route/version, visual evidence plan and operator Start authorization
Stable BMC network/power, update/activation timing and no-interruption policy
OOB access, rollback/rescue image, post-activation host-state and health procedure
test_case.test_command: Do not flash until the host state is approved. In the selected state, record host/BMC power telemetry and current target identity/version, have an authorized operator use BMC Web GPU Management > Firmware to select the exact signed image and press Start, capture visual progress/completion, perform only the approved activation transition, then verify target version and GPU/platform health after recovery. Redfish may collect corroborating state but cannot replace the WebUI path.
test_case.expected_result: The exact target accepts and activates the signed image through BMC Web in the approved host state, visual/update logs show uninterrupted success, pre/post versions prove the transition, and the recovered platform/GPU is healthy without unexpected logs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the authoritative host state, genuine WebUI visual evidence, exact image/target/version transition, completed activation and post-recovery health. Success in the other power state or Redfish-only evidence cannot pass.
safety_gate: Flash requires independent explicit authorization after image/target/compatibility/recovery verification.
Maintain stable BMC network and power; prohibit host power changes outside the approved activation sequence.
Do not guess Redfish update parameters or substitute an API for the source WebUI path.
On interruption, mismatch or unexpected state, preserve evidence and use only the approved rescue path; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Image checksum, target identity and compatibility/current-version baseline
BMC/PLDM update logs and host/BMC power-state telemetry
Post-activation target version, GPU/PCIe health, OS/BMC logs and rollback readiness
test_case.recovery: If update or activation deviates, do not power-cycle or retry automatically; keep BMC/OOB reachable, preserve visual and PLDM logs, and execute only the approved vendor rescue/rollback for the exact target. Revalidate firmware and GPU health afterward.

source_conflict.reason: OS-booted title and standby/do-not-power-on Procedure remain mutually exclusive firmware test states requiring project disposition.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete; execution is prohibited until host state, signed artifact and rescue path are approved.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Select host state/variants and approve image/target, WebUI evidence, activation and rollback/recovery.
pending.owner: GPU firmware, BMC/PLDM, platform power and change-safety owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve one host state or split variants with an exact signed and recoverable BMC-Web flash lifecycle.

project_authority: Host-state support, signed image compatibility, activation and rescue are irreducible vendor/project inputs.
